note: The growth step of the hourly tick (docs 10, 11). habitat: how the 1 m habitat grid is built from the water summary: moisture falls from fresh water to nothing over bankM; the tide band holds at least bandMoisture and bandSalt (0..255); salt falls from the sea and band over saltM. grass: painting decides where grass is at once; the grass cover per cell (how well grass likes the ground) follows the ground slowly, moving toward its target by ratePerH of the gap each game hour, so a dug pond drowns its grass over about a day and drained ground greens again; grass thins in standing water and on salty ground (saltFrom: thinning starts, saltFull: none from this salt up). maxPlants caps the individual plants on the island. species: the flora recipes that grow (recipes/flora/<id>.json). marks: the Plant tool's rings on the ground (UI only): each planted seed gets a ring that grows from tapRadiusM[0] to [1] and fades over tapS seconds; while the tool is open, the player's plantings that are not yet mature carry a youngRadiusM ring at youngOpacity (at most 15, the newest first). A living thing tapped with no tool chosen (the journal's card) gets a ring that blooms in over selectBloomS seconds, then breathes: its radius swells by selectPulse and its opacity moves between selectOpacity over selectPulseS seconds; the ring's size comes from recipes/world/journal.json identify.ringM.
